description: This file provides a task filtering service for a task management backend, including a class for task filtering criteria and a function to apply those filters to retrieve tasks from the database.

classes.name: TaskFilters
classes.description: A class to encapsulate various filtering criteria for tasks, such as project, tags, assignee, priority, due dates, search term, and status.

methods.name: List[Task] filter_tasks(db: Session, filters: TaskFilters)
methods.description: Filters tasks in the database based on the provided TaskFilters criteria and returns a list of matching Task objects.
